title: The Karnataka Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes and Other Backward Classes (Reservation of Appointments, etc.) (Amendment) Bill, 2024
summary: 'The Karnataka Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes and Other Backward Classes (Reservation of Appointments, etc.) (Amendment) Bill, 2024' (Bill No. 39 of 2024) is a State legislative measure introduced in the Karnataka Legislative Assembly (Vidhan Sabha) concerning State Finance / Taxation. The bill introduces statutory amendments to existing state legislation, primarily modifying Act, 1990 (Karnataka Act; Amendment) Act, 2004; In section 3 of the principal Act across 10 identified sections/clauses.
